in_sanskrit.name: एकाग्रह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One-pointed, undisturbed, focused, unified, absorbed, intensive, concentrated

in_marathi.name: Ekagrah
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekagrah हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ekagrah is derived from the Sanskrit word 'eka' meaning one and 'agrah' meaning point or focus. It represents a person with a single-minded focus or intense concentration. In Hindu mythology, Ekagrah is also associated with Lord Shiva, who is known for his unwavering focus and intense devotion.
